cards.question: What does SELECT do?
cards.explanation: SELECT reads data from one or more tables/views.
cards.realWorldUsage: - Fetch data for reports\n- Backend query building

cards.question: INNER JOIN vs LEFT JOIN?
cards.explanation: INNER JOIN keeps only matching rows; LEFT JOIN keeps all left rows plus matches (null if no match).
cards.codeSnippet: SELECT * FROM a\nLEFT JOIN b ON b.a_id = a.id;

cards.question: What is GROUP BY used for?
cards.explanation: It groups rows so aggregate functions (COUNT/SUM/AVG) run per group.
cards.codeSnippet: SELECT country, COUNT(*)\nFROM users\nGROUP BY country;

cards.question: HAVING vs WHERE?
cards.explanation: WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters groups after aggregation.
cards.codeSnippet:
SELECT country, COUNT(*) c
FROM users
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

cards.question: What is an index?
cards.explanation: A data structure that speeds up lookups at the cost of extra write/storage.
cards.realWorldUsage: - Fix slow queries\n- Support unique constraints
